svg.title: The Jarvis logo
svg.desc: The owl logo in colour on the dark and the light background, and its two one-colour variants: ink on light and ivory on dark.
svg.text: Colour on both themes, and the one-colour variants for print and single-colour use.
The vector master is design/assets/logo.svg; every file here is derived from it.
Left eye product blue, right eye coral, outline #17121C, face #F2E6D4.
